summary: The real Shopify development preview satisfies the objective acceptance criteria. More From the Studio has coherent page-width geometry at desktop, tablet, and mobile; all four cards and the collection link remain inside the content boundary; editorial titles are optional presentation-only fallbacks while Shopify product URLs and prices remain authoritative. Empty In Their Space content collapses, the duplicate homepage footer newsletter is suppressed, Teklo identity appears in the homepage header and footer, and the approved four-step process retains all four images with polished SEND copy. Hero video support is prepared with image and reduced-motion fallbacks; active video playback remains intentionally untested because no approved video is configured.

desktop.notes: Genuine Shopify development-preview evidence. At the 1440 viewport, document scrollWidth is 1425 and the catalog cards span x=50 through x=1374.8 without clipping. Transparent card backgrounds, aligned heading/link geometry, complete product metadata, and surrounding process context are visible. Additional fresh captures cover the hero/header, full process section, and Studio Notes/footer transition.

mobile.notes: Genuine Shopify development-preview evidence. At the 390 viewport, document scrollWidth is 375 and catalog content remains between x=15 and x=360.2; all four title/price pairs have no overlap and View All remains fully visible at x=15 through x=159.6. Direct measurements also contain the Studio Notes heading, body, form, input, and JOIN button within x=16 through x=359.2. Additional fresh captures cover the hero/header, catalog-to-process transition, full process sequence, and Studio Notes/footer.

theme_check.notes: Shopify Theme Check inspected 162 files and reported 11 warnings across 8 pre-existing, untouched files. No warning is new or attributable to this iteration.
